note: protocols are defined per structure; dataset applicability and exceptions are in verification/anomaly_protocols.md; no injection has been run

P-NEST.ground_truth: controlled injection, (record, path) recorded; natural optional fields and type variation are baselined
P-NEST.needs: records with nested objects, arrays and optional fields kept unflattened

P-REL.ground_truth: controlled injection, (table, key, relation) recorded; natural orphans are baselined and excluded from labels
P-REL.needs: keys of every table and a complete foreign-key baseline

P-SEQ.ground_truth: controlled injection on event sequences; native labels only where the source gives them
P-SEQ.needs: event order and event type; timestamps only for gap and delay mechanisms

P-TAB.needs: row-local values; cross-field rules need the whole row; transactional rules need entity history

P-TS.ground_truth: controlled injection, window start and end recorded
P-TS.needs: regular or documented time index; context needs history
